options swap_delay=12 iteration=20 ignore_burst_energy=true;
energy every interval=480,720 amount=1;

venti char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
venti add weapon="favoniuswarbow" refine=1 lvl=90/90;
venti add set="viridescentvenerer" count=4;

xiangling char lvl=90/90 cons=0 talent=9,9,9;
xiangling add weapon="thecatch" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
xiangling add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

kaeya char lvl=90/90 cons=6 talent=9,9,9;
kaeya add weapon="harbingerofdawn" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
kaeya add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

thoma char lvl=90/90 cons=4 talent=9,9,9;
thoma add weapon="blacktassel" refine=5 lvl=90/90;
thoma add set="emblemofseveredfate" count=4;

target lvl=100 resist=0.1 radius=2 pos=0,2.4 hp=999999999;

active xiangling;
for let i = 0; i < 3; i = i + 1 {
  xiangling skill;
  kaeya skill, burst;
  thoma skill, burst;
  xiangling burst;
  venti skill, burst;
  xiangling attack:12;
  wait(300);
}
